description: A fractal explorer whose picture is handed to an Iris oscillator as its wavetable source, so panning and zooming the fractal reshapes the sound

params.text: Opens a list of the fourteen built-in fractals and draws the one you pick
Puts the view back to the whole fractal, at the starting zoom and centre

inputs.text: Zooms the view in and out continuously while a voltage is present, +10V zooming in at full speed, -10V out at full speed and 0V leaving the view where it is
Pans the view sideways at a speed set by the voltage, +10V moving right at full speed, -10V left, and 0V leaving the view where it is
Pans the view up and down at a speed set by the voltage, +10V moving one way at full speed, -10V the other, and 0V leaving the view where it is

notes: this module is marked hidden in the plugin, so it does not appear in Rack's module browser; the way to get one is the Iris right-click menu, which adds it
place it immediately to the left of an Iris, not to the right; Iris only reads a Nautiloid that is its left neighbour
drag the picture to pan, and use the mouse wheel over it to zoom; neither gesture can be clicked for its own note, because the picture is one drawn widget
LOC CODE is a sixteen-character code for where you are in the fractal; the two small buttons beside it copy it to the clipboard and paste one back, which is how a view is shared
